preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 105, inclusive.
The capital city s is a valid city number between 1 and n, inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
Each road connects two different cities vi and ui, which are valid city numbers between 1 and n, inclusive.
Each road has a length wi between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The distance l from the capital to the missile silos is between 0 and 109, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the number of missile silos located in Berland.
